newsitem.title: UK: UK confirms BT 800 mln stg defence deal.
newsitem.headline: UK confirms BT 800 mln stg defence deal.

text.p: The British government said on Thursday it had completed contractual negotiations with a consortium led by British Telecommunications Plc for a 10-year contract worth more than 800 million stg to provide a fixed telecoms system for Britain's armed forces.
BT-led INCA was named as preferred bidder for the contract, the largest defence ministry deal ever under the private finance initiative, in November.

"Under the contract, which will be signed tomorrow, ownership and responsibility for the operation and maintenance of most of the defence fixed telecommunications assets in Great Britain will pass to the private sector," junior defence minister John Spellar said in a written parliamentary answer. -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427767
